source_refs.note: Exercise 2.1, Question 10: differentiate y = sqrt(sin x) + cos sqrt(x); book p. 41. Unit 2 has no printed answers.

blocks.prompt: 10. Differentiate w.r.t. the variable involved: \(y = \sqrt{\sin x} + \cos\sqrt{x}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do terms hain aur dono composite hain, lekin dono mein layers ulti tarteeb mein hain.
\(\sqrt{\sin x}\) mein bahar root hai aur andar \(\sin x\); \(\cos\sqrt{x}\) mein bahar \(\cos\) hai aur andar \(\sqrt{x}\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Rule kaunsa? Har term par alag chain rule, phir sum rule se jama.
Plan: pehle har term mein 'bahar kaun, andar kaun' pehchanenge, phir bahar ka derivative darja andar ka derivative.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \sqrt{\sin x} + \cos\sqrt{x}\), jahan \(x > 0\) aur \(\sin x > 0\).
Maloom karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: sum rule, aur har term par chain rule. Shart isliye ke dono square roots ke andar positive cheez chahiye, aur derivative ke liye zero bhi nahi.

Pehli term: \(\sin x\) ka root
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}(\sin x)^{1/2} = \tfrac{1}{2}(\sin x)^{-1/2}\cos x\]
\[= \dfrac{\cos x}{2\sqrt{\sin x}}\]
Kyun: bahar \(u^{1/2}\) hai jahan \(u = \sin x\). Power rule se \(\frac{1}{2}u^{-1/2}\), aur phir andar ka derivative \(\cos x\) se multiply kiya.

Doosri term: \(\sqrt{x}\) ka cos
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\cos\sqrt{x} = -\sin\sqrt{x} \cdot \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\]
Kyun: bahar \(\cos w\) hai jahan \(w = \sqrt{x}\). \((\cos w)' = -\sin w\), aur andar ka derivative \((x^{1/2})' = \frac{1}{2}x^{-1/2} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\cos\sqrt{x}\) aur \(\sqrt{\cos x}\) alag cheezein hain. Pehle dekh lein ke root kis ke upar hai.

Dono jama karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{\cos x}{2\sqrt{\sin x}} - \dfrac{\sin\sqrt{x}}{2\sqrt{x}}\]
Kyun: sum rule; doosri term ka minus sign \((\cos)' = -\sin\) se aaya.

Tasdeeq \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par
\[\dfrac{0}{2} - \dfrac{\sin\sqrt{\pi/2}}{2\sqrt{\pi/2}} \approx -0.379\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\sin x\) apni chouti (peak) par hai, to \(\sqrt{\sin x}\) ka slope zero; pehli term ka 0 aana theek hai. Doosri term negative hai kyunke \(\cos\sqrt{x}\) wahan ghat raha hai (\(\sqrt{\pi/2} \approx 1.25\), jahan cos ghatta hai).
